notes: The variant unit WLC.2KI.20.4.v001 is selected to r01, covering s006 and s007, and the ASV's 'the middle part of the city' matches that reading; the margin's 'middle court' was read and set aside under rule 38.
The margin 'Or, out of' does not move the 'into' aligned to s007; the printed text governs.

לֹא takes the temporal 'before', on the reasoning by which rule 17 gives 'ere' to the negative of a temporal clause; the apodosis waw takes the frame's 'that' under rule 45, since the ASV writes it at the apodosis head.
